title: Studies of NGC 6720 with Calibrated HST/WFC3 Emission-line Filter Images. I. Structure and Evolution

evidence.locator: Sect. III.1, restating the model of O'Dell, Sabbadin & Henney (2007): a triaxial ellipsoid with a semi-major axis of 44 arcsec (0.16 pc at 740 pc) along position angle about 60 degrees, a semi-minor axis of 30 arcsec perpendicular to it, both in the equatorial plane, and a semi-polar axis of about 59 arcsec tipped 6.5 +/- 2 degrees from the line of sight; the south-west end of the main ring moves away from the observer. Sect. III.6: the 2013 model elaborates that work and reaches similar conclusions on the main ring. Sect. III.4: the Inner Halo's loops lie almost all within 65 arcsec of the central star; the Outer Halo is a thin shell of radius 115 arcsec.
